title: Commercial Support Associate
description:
Location: Berlin , hybrid (2-3 days per week in our office)
 Hi, we're AMBOSS and we're searching for a Commercial Support Associate to support how we manage tenders, vendor registrations, and customer assurance requests for our institutional customers.
 About AMBOSS AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.
 Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.
 Why can this position be exciting for you? In this role, you'll coordinate the tenders, vendor registrations, and documentation requests that let institutional and business customers say yes to AMBOSS. You'll sit at the center of the company, working closely with Sales and pulling in expertise from IT, Legal, Finance, Product, Security, and Engineering to get every request answered accurately and on time.
 Every tender we win and every questionnaire we complete well helps bring AMBOSS into more hospitals, health systems, and medical schools: directly supporting our mission of empowering medical professionals to provide the best possible care.
 You'll start with structured, recurring processes and grow into someone institutional customers and internal teams alike rely on to get things done.
 You will: Support tender and procurement processes, coordinating the company information, documentation, and internal contributions they require.
 Complete and maintain customer vendor registrations and onboarding requirements in procurement and vendor-managem…

title: Pflegepädagog:in als Educational Engagement Representative bei Novaheal
description:
Hallo, wir sind AMBOSS und wir suchen eine:n Educational Engagement Representative für Novaheal, um unsere Lern-App in Pflegeschulen und Bildungseinrichtungen in den gesamten deutschsprachigen Raum zu bringen.
 Warum AMBOSS? AMBOSS ist der Copilot für den medizinischen Alltag. Mit unserer Plattform unterstützen wir Fachkräfte bei der Fortbildung sowie bei klinischen Entscheidungen, um stets die bestmögliche Patientenversorgung zu gewährleisten. Unser Team vereint Fürsorge, innovative Ideen und modernste KI-basierte Medizintechnologie. Gegründet wurde AMBOSS 2012 von Ärztinnen und Ärzten, die genau das Tool entwickeln wollten, das ihnen im Studium und in der Klinik gefehlt hat. Seitdem sind wir auf über 600 Mitarbeitende gewachsen und in mehr als 180 Ländern aktiv, vor allem in Deutschland und den USA. Unsere Büros befinden sich in Berlin, Köln, New York, Cagliari und Kapstadt.
 Du möchtest mehr über unsere Kultur erfahren? Schau dir unser Video an.
 Über Novaheal bei AMBOSS Für den Bereich der Pflegeausbildung ist die AMBOSS NOVAHEAL GmbH seit 2024 Teil der AMBOSS SE. NOVAHEAL wurde von erfahrenen Pflegefachpersonen entwickelt und bietet eine breite Palette an Lerninhalten, die gezielt auf die Anforderungen der Pflegeausbildung zugeschnitten sind.
 Gemeinsam stehen wir für eine werteorientierte Unternehmenskultur und verbinden die Leidenschaft für innovative Bildung im Gesundheitswesen mit einem klaren Ziel: die Pflegebranche – und insbesondere die Pflegeausbildung – nachhaltig zu stärken und zu transformieren.
 Als Teil unseres Teams im B2B Relationship Management bist du die treibende Kraft hinter der Einführung und erfolgreichen Implementierung unserer Lern-App in Institutionen des Gesundheitswesens und trägst aktiv zum Ausbau unserer Kooperationen bei. Durch deine Erfahrung aus Pflege, Praxisanleitung, Wissenschaft und/oder Pädagogik sprichst du die Sprache unserer Vertragspartner und kannst ihre Herausforderungen nicht nur nachvollziehen, sondern auch gezielt…

title: Junior Sales Manager DACH (Remote in Germany)
description:
Hi, we're AMBOSS and we're looking for a Junior Sales Manager to help bring Novaheal to nursing schools across Germany.
 About AMBOSS AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.
 Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.
 Why can this position be exciting for you? Novaheal is our learning platform for nursing students and nursing professionals — the same idea behind AMBOSS, built for a group that has been underserved by good digital tools for far too long. You'll own the full sales cycle with nursing schools: finding them, talking to them, running the demo, and signing them. You'll also join a team of nurses, so the people around you know the classrooms and wards you're selling into and can tell you straight away whether a pitch rings true. Because the team is small, you won't be handed a narrow slice of the funnel; you'll see a deal from first email to signature and learn what actually moves the needle. Every school that switches to Novaheal means hundreds of nursing students learning with better material, which is exactly the kind of impact we're here for.
 You will: Own the full sales cycle for nursing schools from first outreach to closed contract
 Build a pipeline of nursing schools through outbound calls, emails, and events

title: Senior Risk Management Specialist (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋
 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.
 lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.
 As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.
 Your Mission
 As Senior Risk Management Specialist, you will help scale and further develop lemon.markets’ Risk Management Framework in a period of growing regulatory expectations, business complexity, and organisational maturity. Sitting within the Risk team and working closely with the Head of Risk, you will take over meaningful responsibilities across multiple risk domains and help ensure our controls, assessments, and governance evolve with the company. Over the next 6 to 12 months, your focus will be on strengthening risk processes across operational and non-financial risk topics, contributing to financial risk topics such as ICAAP and ILAAP, and improving the structure, transparency, and efficiency of our risk tooling and reporting.
